title: Gaussian generator and Ornstein–Uhlenbeck differential
statement: Let $f,g:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ be such that $f$ has Gaussian generator $g$, and suppose that $f$ is three times continuously differentiable. Then $g$ agrees almost everywhere, with respect to the product standard Gaussian measure, with the Ornstein–Uhlenbeck differential of $f$.
